name: Mercenary Searing Torch
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Searing Torch (players/witch_hunter/mercenary/searing_torch_merc.sval, 25 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 2 (in brackets): damage 100 (120); 0.5 s between torches. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon. Numbers are HoH1's, not this port's.
summary: Casting a skill throws a torch at a nearby enemy for 100 magical damage and burning, at most once per 0.5 s.
